changes: Clip validation checks independently decoded linear RGB (2e-6), with separate independent conversion/transfer tests and transfer-aware encoded intervals.
MINDE validation enforces explicit per-gamut deltaEOK limits: sRGB 0.0002, P3 0.00025, Rec.2020 0.0015. Encoded differences are diagnostic.
Threshold regression permits either valid native stopping decision; it does not require f32 to disagree with f64.
Shared gamut marker type implements both precision lanes; validation takes one type, with no runtime name-pair assertion or fallback budget.
One core registry and P3 extras registry feed common timing, checksum and validation code. Workloads built once. Uniform table order and labels.
P3 multiply-based compatibility conversion delegates to typed kernel. Pinned coefficient consistency tests and shared independent reference conversion.
Missing --gamut values get a specific diagnostic; strict unknown-argument rejection retained and documented.

p3_preservation.comparison: All output to_bits bytes equal to the original pre-refactor baseline snapshot.

input_description.comparison: cmp of raw little-endian to_bits() for all three output channels, f64 followed by f32 for each input; no tolerance
input_description.corpus: Existing 35,640-color grid and same-sized random workload; 32,768 mixed and 32,768 low-chroma samples from mulberry32 seed 0x6d756c74; 144 endpoint/extreme-hue samples. Inputs to f32 rounded before mapping.

benchmark.checksum: All three output channels consumed during timing; f32 outputs widened individually for accumulation.

experiments.reason: No consistent improvement across both workloads and precisions in initial screening; candidates left outside working tree.

limitations: Empirical corpus budgets, not full-domain or cross-platform guarantees. Validation was run on the recorded Linux/glibc environment.
Native f32 P3 MINDE median remains 3.9% slower on grid and 1.8% slower on random versus original baseline; no speculative performance change adopted.
Cached f64 cubic grid median was 1.6% slower in this run; individual baseline times ranged 52.84-58.67 ns. The earlier 9.1% regression did not reproduce consistently.
Unported hue-quantized P3 solvers retain historical workload budgets, which are not guaranteed for arbitrary boundary inputs. Expanded face validation targets clip and MINDE.
Unknown CLI arguments continue to exit 2, now documented as a compatibility change.
--gamut all has a fixed target order; separate balanced target processes are needed for cross-target performance comparisons.
